Make a LARGE spacious top-down oval hall, wide landscape 4:3, zoomed out. Layout: SOUTH a beige dirt path at the bottom edge center into a WIDE empty green grass courtyard (lots of open walking space, few objects). NORTH the wooden counter, shelves, two windows, a couple of hay mounds and sacks and logs — do not fill the courtyard with hay. Keep chunky GBA pixels. No Pelipper, no characters, no text, no UI, no magenta.
